concepts.name: 01 — THE EXPEDITION
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished, high-fidelity design presentation for a proposed redesign of Erudoza, a Scripture study and Bible competition preparation web app for SDA Pathfinder youth and their coaches. This is a visual concept for user selection. Use the attached images as brand/style references: reference 1 is the approved embroidered flame above open Bible logo (preserve its identity as closely as possible); reference 2 is the existing mountain lake, open Bible, compass and gold neckerchief art; reference 3 is the existing field-guide art; reference 4 is an existing embroidered Honor patch texture reference. Erudoza name MUST remain real typeset text in Georgia serif, NEVER embroidered lettering. All other UI headings, body and labels in a crisp system sans font. Palette: deep navy #102e47, warm ivory #f6f4ee, near-white #fffefa, teal #087d80; restrained golden-yellow/red only within Pathfinder objects and patch art. Use clean rounded rectangular 44px controls, 12px radius, clear hierarchy, generous whitespace and solid readable surfaces. High visual craft, not a generic startup template. No glassmorphism, no purple, no fantasy RPG, no military look, no fake testimonials or participation numbers, no rankings or official certification claims. Pathfinder cues: a folded golden neckerchief with subtle red trim, hiking trail, compass, mountain/forest, field journal, open Scripture and embroidered patches. Meaningful functional public-page content only: assigned passage study, review, competition rehearsal, coach-led Team Practice, and Honors shown as sample artwork. Keep support a very small footer link "Support Erudoza", no floating obstruction.
OUTPUT: one landscape high-resolution presentation board, approximately 1920x1440. On a neutral warm-gray artboard show a LARGE crisp flat desktop landing page mockup on left (roughly 72% of board width), plus a narrow phone version at right (roughly 23%), both front-on with no perspective. Desktop represents approximately 1440px viewport width, phone represents 390px. Show entire coherent landing page from header through coach invitation/footer in desktop; phone shows header, hero, primary actions and next section, no microscopic full-page squeeze. No laptop hardware. Both screens must match the same concept. Labels above desktop and phone: "DESKTOP" and "MOBILE". Board title at top specified below. Make all visible text deliberate, short and readable. Each page header has the approved emblem alongside text "Erudoza", small tagline optional "Study. Master. Compete.", and "Sign in". Use exact feature names without inventing APIs. Primary CTA "Start studying", secondary CTA "Coach your team"; a coach section link "Create your club". Student note "Use the account provided by your coach." Include small "Install app" text link if space permits. These are composition mockups, not a product dashboard.
CONCEPT: A — The Expedition. Board title "A / The Expedition" and subtitle "Immersive landscape · Clear purpose · Pathfinder spirit".
Make the most compelling recommended option. Bold integrated hero across the desktop width: left 48% is solid deep navy that blends organically at its right edge into large mountain-lake campsite illustration; right 52% is rich detailed painterly mountain, forest, open Bible, brass compass and yellow neckerchief on rock. Preserve the broad mountain-world look of reference 2 while recompose into a taller feature, WITHOUT a sun disk. This is ONE integrated hero, not landscape banner stacked over an unrelated text area. Airy typography on navy, small gold micro-label "SCRIPTURE. TEAMWORK. PURPOSE." Huge bold sans headline exact "Rooted in Scripture.
Ready for the journey." Short body "Build confident recall, one passage at a time. Prepare for Bible competition with your team." Teal Start studying and ivory Coach your team buttons clearly readable below; note beneath. Under hero an ivory editorial section heading "A clear path to confident recall." Three simple horizontal stations connected by a very restrained dotted trail, each with a small icon or small patch-like accent, numbers 01 02 03, labels "Study the Word", "Strengthen your recall", "Prepare together"; short one-sentence support. Keep trail only behind non-text gaps. Bottom broad near-white coach invitation with small landscape/lantern illustration: headline "Guide your team’s next step.", body "Assign passages, follow progress, and prepare together.", link "Create your club". Small footer. Mobile: compact navy header, a cropped hero art strip preserving Bible and neckerchief, the same headline on solid navy, stacked CTA buttons visible, beginning of ivory trail steps. Artboard has generous spacing between two screen mockups. Prioritize stunning landscape and clean navy/ivory rhythm.
concepts.refinement: Refine this exact Erudoza concept A presentation board; preserve all artwork, composition, colors, spacing, device views, and all text unless specified. Only these targeted corrections: 1. In BOTH desktop and mobile website views change the section heading "A clear path to confident recall." to a clean bold system SANS serif font matching the main hero heading, keeping its size and position. 2. In desktop change "Guide your team’s next step." to that same system sans font. 3. Remove the desktop top-nav links Study, Practice, Team Practice, Honors, Resources, leaving that region empty so the emblem+wordmark left and Install app / Sign in right remain the only header elements. 4. Replace mobile header hamburger icon with legible text "Sign in". 5. Remove the small handwritten slogan from the illustrated notebook, leave its paper blank. Keep the board title and actual Erudoza wordmarks in existing serif; those are brand text. Do not introduce extra changes.

CONCEPT: B — The Field Guide. Board title "B / The Field Guide" and subtitle "Warm editorial · Scripture first · Tactile details".
Make an airy, warm, bookish Pathfinder field-journal composition with large ivory background and a slim navy header. It must be clearly different from cinematic concept A: NO giant panoramic banner or navy hero. Hero desktop left is quiet generous typography on solid ivory: small teal label "YOUR SCRIPTURE FIELD GUIDE", huge bold sans headline exact "Know the Word.
Carry it with you." Body "Turn assigned passages into lasting recall, with focused study and purposeful review." Teal Start studying and outline Coach your team. Right is a sophisticated editorial still-life illustration of an open Bible, closed navy field journal with the approved flame/Bible emblem, brass compass and folded gold Pathfinder neckerchief with red edging, tucked evergreen sprig; fine organic painterly edges on cream background. Add a subtle topographic contour motif ONLY around far empty perimeter and a tiny red fabric bookmark. Rich material rendering belongs only in illustration, never paper texture behind reading text or fake stacked UI frames. Under hero is a tasteful horizontal section headed "Your training, chapter by chapter." On left a slender numbered editorial index with three rows "01 Learn your passages", "02 Review with purpose", "03 Rehearse with your team", each one concise supporting sentence. On right three small attractive embroidered sample Honors displayed on an ivory strip with caption "A glimpse of Erudoza Honors" and smaller label "Sample artwork"; no progress percentages, no invented earned state. Use patch reference for texture family, with book/mountain/compass imagery. Bottom clean narrow navy coach invitation "Help every student find their next step." and ivory "Create your club" control. Keep warm considered field-guide detail, page breathes, just a few separators, not card overload. Mobile shows navy compact header, headline on ivory first, both stacked buttons, a smaller contained Bible/compass/neckerchief illustration beneath and top of numbered index. Main text always readable sans; only wordmark and optional tiny Scripture quote Georgia. Do not include an actual Scripture quote if uncertain of its exact wording.
concepts.refinement: Refine this exact Erudoza concept B presentation board; preserve all artwork, composition, colors, spacing, device views, and all text unless specified. Keep its size and layout. 2. Replace mobile header hamburger icon with legible text "Sign in". 3. Remove the handwritten "Same Scripture. Brighter Journeys." annotations near the illustration on BOTH desktop and mobile; leave this small area clean ivory or keep nearby mountain brush edges. Keep all other objects and text, including "Sample artwork", exactly where they are. Keep the board title and Erudoza wordmarks serif, those are brand text. Do not introduce extra changes.

CONCEPT: C — The Basecamp. Board title "C / The Basecamp" and subtitle "Youthful energy · Team identity · Shared preparation".
Create an energetic premium Pathfinder club basecamp landing page, distinctly different from A immersive landscape and B quiet field-journal. Navy header with emblem and Erudoza wordmark; mostly ivory page. Hero left has huge bold sans headline exact "Stronger in Scripture.
Stronger together." small teal eyebrow "YOUR TEAM’S SCRIPTURE BASECAMP"; body "Study your passages. Sharpen your recall. Bring your best to team practice." Buttons Start studying teal and Coach your team outline. Hero right: a beautifully art-directed large rounded navy illustration panel featuring a modest alpine basecamp with gold canvas tents, forest silhouettes, an open Bible/compass in foreground, and three complete embroidered decorative club badges arranged thoughtfully along lower edge: mountain, open book, compass.
